newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Sky City's Carr resigns, Davies replaces.
newsitem.headline: Sky City's Carr resigns, Davies replaces.

text.p: Sky City Ltd said on Friday that Tom Carr, Chief Executive of its operating subsidiary, Harrah's Sky City, had resigned.
Evan Davies would take over the Chief Executive responsibilities for the Group in addition to his role as Managing Director of Sky City.
Day-to-day responsibility for the operations of the Sky City entertainment complex would be assumed by Tom Dingman in the newly created position of Chief Operating Officer, Sky City said.
Sky City officials were not immediately available for comment to Reuters. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
